unitUs.reason: the file names no protocol, and D24 wants a unit to check the closing gap against; the shortest duration of its raw data, 471 us, is the largest unit the capture can have, and no duration is computed from it
unitUs.source: flipper-irdb@d126fb1 SoundBars/Ultimea/Ultimea_Poseidon_M20.ir: the raw data of its buttons

defaultGapUs.reason: Flipper's raw data ends on a mark and records no gap after it; the firmware sends a silence of 180 ms before every raw transmission, so that is the space between one send of the signal and the next

forms.source: flipper-irdb@d126fb1 SoundBars/Ultimea/Ultimea_Poseidon_M20.ir:108 name 'Bass Up' (added in dfad4b4 on 2026-04-09; raw, 38000 Hz, duty cycle 0.33, 71 durations ending on a mark): the durations as given, a mark first, the closing space the firmware's silence before a raw transmission (180 ms)

truncated.reason: the capture ends on its last mark: Flipper's raw data has no final space, so the signal's closing gap is the protocol block's defaultGapUs and not evidence
